what_it_does: Protects individuals and businesses against cyber-attacks, data breaches, and identity theft.
coverage: Legal expenses for cybercrime defense and regulatory inquiries
Financial loss due to cyber theft or online fraud (as per policy limits)
key_checks_before_buying: Whether social-engineering scams and phishing are covered or excluded
Coverage and limits for business interruption due to cyber-attacks
Ransomware coverage, including ransom payment and negotiation support limits
Retroactive date (does it cover past unknown incidents discovered later?)
Notification and PR costs for informing affected customers after a breach
Any deductibles or sub-limits for specific cyber events

what_it_does: Provides health and liability cover for pets, including illness, accidents, and some routine care.
coverage: Annual wellness or routine care in some variants
Third-party liability if the pet injures someone or damages property
key_checks_before_buying: Breed restrictions or higher premiums for certain breeds
Waiting periods for illness and accident claims
Whether hereditary or congenital conditions are covered or excluded
Minimum and maximum age limits for entry and renewal
Vaccination and medical history requirements for claims
Any sub-limits per condition or per policy year
